action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Mini-XML used unbounded recursion when deleting and
writing XML nodes. An attacker could possibly use these issues to cause
Mini-XML to crash, resulting in a denial of service. These issues only
affected Ubuntu 16.04 LTS. (CVE-2016-4570, CVE-2016-4571)

It was discovered that Mini-XML incorrectly handled certain floating point
values when writing XML nodes, leading to a stack-based buffer overflow. An
attacker could possibly use this issue to cause Mini-XML to crash,
resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code.
(CVE-2018-20004)
isummary:
Mini-XML could be made to crash or run programs if it opened a specially
crafted file.
title: Mini-XML vulnerabilities
